Name: Bold Upscaled Anime Eyes
Author: twilightdvsn
Description:
Gives the farmer higher resolution anime style eyes. Currently only for the girl farmer.

Requires Scale Up Unofficial and Content Patcher.

This is NOT a Fashion Sense texture pack, other mods that use higher resolution textures to give the player different eyes have a bug where the eyes texture will be offset from the farmer's body when riding a horse. Fashion Sense is still compatible, just not a dependency.

Available eye colors include amber, blue, brown, gray, green, hazel, pink, purple, and red. Changeable with GMCM or by manually changing the config.json file. In the future I might make a version for the guy farmers.

I hope you guys enjoy and please leave any questions, concerns, or requests in the comments section <3
